title: Post Soviet Population in Sarasota
text:
The Census Bureau’s B05006 table reports the birthplace of the foreign-born population, not ethnicity or ancestry. The chart compares Sarasota County estimates from three non-overlapping American Community Survey (ACS) five-year periods. It includes countries with a separate B05006 category; some former Soviet republics are not listed separately. Error bars show each estimate’s margin of error (MOE), so small changes should be interpreted cautiously.
To download updated estimates, run Rscript download_birthplace_data.R from the project directory. The chart below reads the saved CSV and does not download data during rendering.
